Covers from Korea to India, from Russia to Brunei.

Covers from Korea to India, from Russia to Brunei. Shows the world known to the Chinese, with China at the center of the map. Wood block print. Relief shown pictorially. Based on the original map drawn by Huang Qianren in 1767. Hummel purchase 1930, no. 18. Includes text. Scale ca. 1:2,500,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Prev. call#: G3200 1811 .T3 AACR2: 650; 700/2
